active.title: USB and Drive copies are encrypted
active.descriptionOnServer: Every archive copied to the USB drive or Google Drive is encrypted and unreadable without the private key. The key is kept on this server: restores from this app use it automatically.
active.descriptionOffServer: Every archive copied to the USB drive or Google Drive is encrypted. The private key is no longer on this server: restore will ask you for it.
active.remove: Remove the key from this server
active.removeConfirm: Remove the private key from this server? Restoring USB/Drive copies will then require pasting it. Without your own copy, those backups would be permanently unreadable.

pending.title: Keep a copy of your private encryption key
pending.description: USB and Drive copies are now encrypted. The private key stays on this server for restores, but if the server is lost or destroyed it goes with it: keep a copy elsewhere.
pending.warning: Store it in a password manager or print it, never on the USB drive or on Drive: that would defeat the encryption.
pending.savedCheckbox: I have saved this key somewhere safe, outside this server.

prompt.title: Encrypted archive
prompt.description: "{{fileName}}" is encrypted. Paste the backup private key to decrypt and restore it.
prompt.wrongKey: This key does not match this archive.
prompt.invalidFormat: Invalid key format: it must start with "pwa-admin-key-v1:".

state.plainHint: Unencrypted drive: anyone who plugs it in can read its contents.
state.unlockedHint: Encrypted (LUKS) drive, currently unlocked and usable.
state.lockedHint: Encrypted (LUKS) drive that is locked: enter the passphrase to use it.

locked.title: Encrypted USB drive is locked
locked.description: {{label}} ({{device}}) is encrypted. Enter the passphrase to unlock it.

encrypt.warning: This ERASES EVERYTHING on {{device}} ({{label}}), backups included. It cannot be undone.
encrypt.mismatch: The two passphrases do not match.
encrypt.passphraseWarning: Write this passphrase down outside this server: without it (and without the keyfile) the drive is permanently unreadable.
encrypt.keyfile: Unlock automatically when plugged in (keyfile stored on this server)
encrypt.keyfileHint: Without this, the passphrase must be entered every time the drive is plugged in, and scheduled backups fail while it is locked.
encrypt.working: Encrypting, this can take several minutes…

errors.confirmation_mismatch: The confirmation does not match the partition name.
errors.usb_partition_not_found: USB partition not found (unplugged or already in use).
errors.partition_still_mounted: The partition is still mounted: eject it first.
errors.mapper_busy: The encrypted volume is in use by another process.
errors.invalid_passphrase_length: The passphrase must be 8 to 256 characters.
errors.eject_failed_still_mounted: Eject failed: the drive is still mounted, do not unplug it.
errors.unmount_failed: Could not unmount the drive (files still in use?).
errors.device_disconnected: The USB drive disconnected during the operation: check the cable and port, then try again.
errors.luks_open_failed: Failed to open the encrypted volume.
errors.unsupported_inner_filesystem: The drive is encrypted but has no readable filesystem (interrupted format?): use "Reformat".
